notes: Employment demand uses SHRUG's 2013 Economic Census city-wide workplace total for Mumbai, redistributed using real 2011 Census worker counts. Mumbai's worker counts are published at 97 fine-ward codes, but the only available public ward-boundary file is the coarser 24-ward BMC administrative map, so the fine-ward counts are aggregated up to admin wards via a public crosswalk table (the only non-government source used anywhere in this project's ward-level work) before being used as weights. All 97 fine-ward codes and all 24 admin wards matched cleanly, with 0 left unmatched. (The same lat/lon coordinate-order bug found in Kolkata's boundary file was also present here and fixed the same way.) Jobs placed within wards via OSM building footprints by type; population and commute data follow the standard project pipeline.
